ingest_disposition.reason: Inbox was quiescent after the already-accounted Stop-hook packet. This delta is a nonduplicate direct-source refinement of the current Stop/retrieval binding frontier.

direct_source_crosscheck.finding: MicroClay.retrieve mints a unique retrieval_id and persists it together with turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id and generation plus query_hash. Strong round-scoped correlation identity already exists in the donor; Frankenstein 2.0 does not need to invent a second retrieval identity namespace.

_microclay_schatten explicitly creates fresh round-scoped causal_id, turn_id and episode_id for every UserPromptSubmit and documents why session-scoped active_turn identity was insufficient. The synthetic turn content is only a MicroClay marker, not the actual user query payload.

_kognition_richten_hook discards the available round identity at Stop time: it re-selects the newest session retrieval lacking modell:relevanz feedback and independently re-reads the last user message from transcript_path. It does not verify that the selected retrieval row's query_hash matches the transcript query it sends to Ollama.

The mechanical Stop feedback path scans up to twenty open retrieval rows by session_id, uses the session-scoped active_turns.episode_id for effects, and searches the accumulated assistant transcript tail. Therefore the same round-binding weakness is broader than the model relevance path: evidence can be gathered from context that is not keyed to each retrieval row's own turn_id/episode_id/causal_id.

MicroClay._apply_credit creates deterministic feedback receipts from retrieval_id, causal_id, generation, signal_class and value. This is useful downstream enforcement, but it cannot repair a wrong retrieval/evidence association made before the reducer is called.

new_architecture_inference.name: RetrievalFeedbackBinding/v2
new_architecture_inference.core_finding: The donor's main gap is not absence of round identity; it is loss of that identity between retrieval creation and later feedback evidence collection.
required_addition: an exact query payload reference or a verifiable bounded query artifact bound to retrieval_id, because retrieval_episodes stores query_hash but the synthetic MicroClay turn does not store the user's query text
typed evidence references for assistant output/effects used by mechanical feedback rather than session-wide transcript tails or active_turns episode lookup
producer runtime/build identity for model-derived feedback
explicit result status and receipt identity

relationship_to_deferred_causal_return_e.finding: DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope/v1 remains a useful common outer interconnect candidate. RetrievalFeedbackBinding/v2 is the retrieval-specific specialization and should reuse the donor's existing strong round IDs rather than replace them.

counterhypotheses: Strictly sequential one-request-at-a-time Stop handling may make newest-open retrieval and latest transcript query coincide in common practice; this does not establish deterministic binding under overlap, timeout, replay or reordered processing.

The current query_hash could be used as a validation check against the transcript query, but the donor Stop path does not perform that comparison and still must first select the correct retrieval row.
An installed wrapper outside the pinned donor may add stronger event-to-retrieval binding; this remains UNKNOWN without exact installed-source evidence.

required_actions: reuse retrieval_id/turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation as the canonical retrieval feedback join rather than creating a parallel identity system
at UserPromptSubmit, bind retrieval_id to an exact query payload reference or otherwise verifiable query artifact; keep query_sha256 as an integrity check
enqueue model relevance work from the exact retrieval created by the originating event instead of querying newest-open-by-session at Stop
bind mechanical feedback to exact assistant/effect evidence IDs for that retrieval round instead of transcript-tail and session active_turn resolution
preserve _apply_credit-style deterministic receipt/idempotence semantics after exact evidence binding
test two same-session retrievals with reversed Stop completion, swapped transcript recency and distinct effects; fail if either model or mechanical feedback crosses rounds

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4/external non-provider test lane: prove exact round binding with two same-session retrievals whose Stop/model completions and transcript recency are intentionally reversed; separately verify mechanical feedback uses only evidence bound to the target retrieval round.
